CIGO EXECUTION TASK — CIGO-P1-BLOCK2

MAJOR PART
Part 1 — Foundation, Product Boundary & Business Truth Architecture

BLOCK
Canonical Domain Model + Business Truth Architecture

OBJECTIVE
Create the first executable CIGO-owned domain/truth kernel and its architecture documentation. The result must define how CIGO represents business entities, provenance, truth classes, tenancy, ownership, lineage, authority and validation without duplicating Business OS operational ownership.

AUTHORITATIVE BOUNDARIES
- Writable repository: sohail654312-gif/codeedge-intelligent-growth-os only.
- Read-only references: codeedge-business-os and codeedge are the primary references for this task.
- Business OS remains the operational system of record for CRM, customers, leads, communications, bookings, voice, operational automation, finance operations and provider execution.
- CIGO owns intelligence, business memory, evidence, analysis, recommendations, decisions, goals/plans and controlled orchestration.
- No direct mutation of Business OS/MVP databases or repositories.
- No provider-specific calls in the domain layer.
- Preserve tenant/workspace isolation, provenance, explainability, auditability, sandbox parity and rollback-safe design.

SELECTED REFERENCES
1. sohail654312-gif/codeedge-business-os — inspect only the portions materially relevant to workspace/membership tenancy, operational entity ownership, provider-neutral Domain→Interface→Adapter boundaries, execution modes, audit evidence and finance/automation contracts. Borrow concepts and naming only where they fit CIGO; do not copy operational modules.
2. sohail654312-gif/codeedge — inspect only tenancy/RLS/security/testing patterns that help enforce workspace isolation and deterministic validation.
Do NOT inspect finance-suite, website, beautifypk-redesign or Preflow.demo for this block unless a concrete dependency emerges; they are not needed to establish the core truth kernel.

REQUIRED ARTIFACTS
A. Architecture docs under docs/architecture:
- CANONICAL-DOMAIN-MODEL.md
- BUSINESS-TRUTH-ARCHITECTURE.md
Each must cover: CIGO-owned vs externally-owned entities; canonical identifiers; workspace/tenant boundary; source-of-truth rules; FACT / ASSUMPTION / ANALYSIS / PREDICTION / RECOMMENDATION / DECISION / ACTION distinctions; provenance/evidence; confidence/verification; lineage/supersession; read/write authority; human approval boundary; failure/ownership semantics; examples across the customer journey.

B. Minimal executable TypeScript domain kernel. Create a clean project skeleton if absent (package.json, tsconfig and test setup) and implement small, framework-independent modules such as:
- src/domain/truth/types.ts
- src/domain/truth/identifiers.ts
- src/domain/truth/provenance.ts
- src/domain/truth/ownership.ts
- src/domain/truth/validation.ts
- src/domain/truth/index.ts
Naming may be adjusted if a cleaner structure is justified.

The kernel must model at minimum:
- WorkspaceId / canonical entity IDs.
- SourceSystem and ownership classification (CIGO-owned vs external operational source).
- Evidence/Provenance records with source, observed/recorded timestamps, external reference and verification status.
- TruthClass = FACT | ASSUMPTION | ANALYSIS | PREDICTION | RECOMMENDATION | DECISION | ACTION.
- Confidence/verification metadata appropriate to non-factual derived intelligence.
- Lineage links from derived intelligence back to supporting evidence/facts.
- Authority metadata for decisions/actions.
- Explicit validation errors/results rather than silent coercion.

C. Deterministic tests demonstrating the invariants below.

MANDATORY INVARIANTS / ACCEPTANCE TESTS
1. A FACT cannot validate without provenance/evidence and a source system.
2. Every canonical CIGO record must be scoped to a workspace/tenant.
3. Evidence or lineage from another workspace must be rejected.
4. An operational entity sourced from Business OS/MVP must remain externally owned; CIGO may reference it but may not claim operational ownership.
5. ANALYSIS/PREDICTION/RECOMMENDATION must retain lineage to supporting evidence or facts.
6. A DECISION or ACTION must include authority evidence/actor and must not silently become approved merely because AI produced it.
7. AI-created assumptions must remain ASSUMPTION unless explicit evidence/confirmation promotes them.
8. Supersession/history must preserve prior record identity instead of destructive overwrite.
9. The domain kernel must contain no Twilio/Meta/Vapi/OpenAI/Stripe/ERPNext or other direct provider implementation.
10. Tests and typecheck must pass.

IMPLEMENTATION QUALITY
- Keep the domain kernel small and provider-neutral; do not build a full database, UI, CRM, finance ledger, booking engine, automation engine or provider adapter in this block.
- Prefer discriminated unions/types and pure validation functions over framework coupling.
- Keep architecture documentation consistent with executable types.
- Add concise comments only where they explain an invariant or trust boundary.

REFERENCE REPORT
Add a short section in one architecture doc named “Reference patterns used” stating:
- what was borrowed conceptually from Business OS and MVP;
- what was deliberately NOT copied;
- why no other reference repo was needed for this block.

VERIFICATION / EVIDENCE
Run the available package install/build/typecheck/tests needed for this minimal kernel. Record:
- exact files created/changed;
- exact test/typecheck commands and results;
- resulting commit SHA(s);
- any reference files inspected;
- any blocker that prevented a required acceptance criterion.

COMPLETION RULE
Mark COMPLETE_FOR_PLANNER only if the executable kernel, docs and deterministic tests are committed in the CIGO repo and all mandatory invariants are demonstrated by passing tests/typecheck. A document-only result is INCOMPLETE, not complete.
